openHint: Track is open: keep drawing from the glowing end to the station. Otherwise the ride ends at the barrier tape.
drawHint: Draw your coaster with one stroke and lead it back to the station. An open end gets a barrier tape: the train flies off or tips over.
drawHintTurn: On the ground: arc towards the back = flat curve. Up high: turn around = banked curve
drawHintLoop: Cross the stroke up high: loop
newStrokeHint: A new stroke replaces the track. Start on the track to improve it.
overdrawHint: Draw over the track to improve it
fail.derail: Too fast into the turn: the train derailed.
fail.fall: Too slow in the loop: the train fell out.
fail.stall: Not enough momentum: the train rolled back.
fail.water: Splash! Without a splash element the water stops the train.
fail.openEnd: Barrier! The track ends here – draw it back to the station.
paint.head: Head
paint.name: Name
tutorial.l1: Put your finger on the ground and draw a hill. Lead the track back to the station, or it ends at the barrier tape.
tutorial.l2: Tap the track and drag the handles
tutorial.l5: Draw a flat arc towards the back on the ground (higher on screen = further back)
tutorial.l8: Climb steeply and draw a loop in the air that crosses itself
